_README: Curated publisher domain -> trust tier for the web-search importer (scripts/ingest_websearch.py). Tiers steer ONLY the triage worksheet ordering and the provenance label; they NEVER enter evidence_score (score_evidence.py keeps its reproducibility guarantee). Every web hit is still source_type 'web_resource' (weight 0.25) and status 'candidate' awaiting human review. A result host matches a tier when it equals a listed domain or is a subdomain of it (suffix match); anything unlisted is 'open' and kept with a rank penalty and a visible marker. Edit this file only through a pull request, like the rest of the evidence graph.
